limits: Only the three public demonstrations supervise the inferred rule.
Equal horizontal/vertical evidence is rejected rather than guessed.
Multiple external on-lattice markers or an internal marker are rejected.
The public evaluation queries have no labels here, so predictions are unverified.
The geometry is structurally unrelated to the selected 3+separator+3 occupancy family; no production transfer is claimed.
The two extra queries are proposed support cases, not hidden evaluation examples; all four outputs are labels under this proposed Racket rule only.

racket.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ([h (length g)]
         [w (length (first g))])
    (define (horizontal? orientation)
      (eq? orientation 'horizontal))
    (define (line-count orientation)
      (if (horizontal? orientation) h w))
    (define (position-count orientation)
      (if (horizontal? orientation) w h))
    (define (cell orientation line position)
      (if (horizontal? orientation)
          (list-ref (list-ref g line) position)
          (list-ref (list-ref g position) line)))
    (define (groups-for orientation)
      (apply append
        (for/list ([line (in-range (line-count orientation))])
          (define positions-by-color (make-hash))
          (for ([position (in-range (position-count orientation))])
            (define color (cell orientation line position))
            (unless (zero? color)
              (hash-update! positions-by-color color
                            (lambda (positions) (cons position positions))
                            '())))
          (for/list ([(color reverse-anchors) (in-hash positions-by-color)]
                     #:when (>= (length reverse-anchors) 2))
            (define anchors (sort reverse-anchors <))
            (define gaps
              (for/list ([left (in-list anchors)]
                         [right (in-list (rest anchors))])
                (- right left)))
            (define step (foldl gcd 0 gaps))
            (list orientation line color anchors step (modulo (first anchors) step))))))
    (define horizontal-groups (groups-for 'horizontal))
    (define vertical-groups (groups-for 'vertical))
    (when (= (length horizontal-groups) (length vertical-groups))
      (error 'public-focus-rule "orientation group counts are tied"))
    (define groups
      (if (> (length horizontal-groups) (length vertical-groups))
          horizontal-groups
          vertical-groups))
    (define planned (make-hash))
    (define (plan-group group)
      (define orientation (list-ref group 0))
      (define line (list-ref group 1))
      (define color (list-ref group 2))
      (define anchors (list-ref group 3))
      (define step (list-ref group 4))
      (define residue (list-ref group 5))
      (define count (position-count orientation))
      (define other-on-lattice
        (for/list ([position (in-range count)]
                   #:when (let ([value (cell orientation line position)])
                            (and (not (zero? value))
                                 (not (= value color))
                                 (= (modulo position step) residue))))
          (list position (cell orientation line position))))
      (define anchor-low (apply min anchors))
      (define anchor-high (apply max anchors))
      (define internal
        (filter (lambda (marker)
                  (and (<= anchor-low (first marker))
                       (<= (first marker) anchor-high)))
                other-on-lattice))
      (define external
        (filter (lambda (marker)
                  (or (< (first marker) anchor-low)
                      (> (first marker) anchor-high)))
                other-on-lattice))
      (unless (empty? internal)
        (error 'public-focus-rule "internal on-lattice marker is unsupported"))
      (when (> (length external) 1)
        (error 'public-focus-rule "multiple external terminal markers are ambiguous"))
      (define marker (if (empty? external) #f (first external)))
      (define paint (if marker (second marker) color))
      (define low (if marker (min anchor-low (first marker)) 0))
      (define high (if marker (max anchor-high (first marker)) (sub1 count)))
      (for ([position (in-range low (add1 high))]
            #:when (= (modulo position step) residue))
        (define key
          (if (horizontal? orientation)
              (cons line position)
              (cons position line)))
        (define previous (hash-ref planned key #f))
        (when (and previous (not (= previous paint)))
          (error 'public-focus-rule "conflicting progression writes"))
        (hash-set! planned key paint)))
    (for ([group (in-list groups)])
      (plan-group group))
    (for/list ([r (in-range h)])
      (for/list ([c (in-range w)])
        (hash-ref planned (cons r c) (list-ref (list-ref g r) c)))))))

reasoning.orientation: Count row-wise and column-wise same-color groups with at least two anchors; use the orientation with the larger count.
reasoning.progression: Use the gcd of anchor gaps as the lattice step. Without an external on-lattice different-color marker, extend that lattice to both grid edges.
reasoning.terminal_marker: A unique external different-color marker on the same lattice becomes the paint color and terminal endpoint; recolor only the segment joining it to the anchors. Off-lattice cells remain unchanged.
